title: ebenus cauliflora
intro: Ebenus cauliflora, commonly known as the Pyrethrum or Pyrethrum daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation due to its health benefits of aiding in digestion and acting as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Ebenus cauliflora include its use in treating fever, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Ebenus cauliflora include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
